item.title: Re: Try again? Fugitive vs the Yakuza
item.content:encoded:
► my detailed thoughts◄
- close

"The foreigner is here. Grab the money, and guard the door." Tsuyaki said to the guards on either side of him.

Feel like you could get rid of this and show Momo just pointing at the protag/door and the guards moving to do what he is saying here… then the next line doesn’t feel so repetitive.

"So tell me. Did you steal this money?"

/Make this a part of the paragraph above, so its clear Momo is speaking.

"There are things I want to put behind me." Tsuyaki takes a long drag on his cigarette.

//This makes me think it is Momo saying the line, when you leave a dialogue tag, it should be of the person speaking. This happens a few times and makes it hard to follow who is speaking.

"Is there a fucking boat!"

This should have a question mark or maybe ?!

"I read your file… They will get you eventually… The GOC doesn't leave loose ends." He says as you hold the gun to his head. You pull the trigger.

//You should break dialogue into its own paragraph, only keeping dialogue tags connected, and then start a new paragraph with “You pull the trigger”

Akhiabara, Japan

Pretty sure Akhiabara is just a district of Tokyo

Echo: We are on the 3rd floor…

Suggest adding in contractions, people don’t usually say “We are” they say “We’re”… this goes for any spoken dialogue

The reality instability is shown to be at its most extreme, and has caused the hallway leading out of the stairwell to stretch infinitely.

So you explain a little but I would describe more here… “most extreme” seems worse than the Hallway extending forever.//

The living room is in complete fluctuation, and in the middle is a young girl around the age of 14.

Suggest explaining the fluctuations.. then break out the description of the girl in another sentence, also suggest saying “young teenager girl” as its hard to guess age by looking.

  • I think you need to up the scary factor about this reality warping, and describe more of the chaos… to raise them stakes

A tip was given to the GOC that Roach had requested work from the owner of the V-House. When a strike was sent to the location, they discovered the entire staff of the club had been murdered. The crime is suspected to have been committed by Roach, though the strike team was unable to locate the fugitive. At this time Roach is still at large.

Is V-House where we originally saw the protag going through time a bunch?

Overall:

  • the turn in the log comes out of nowhere… I think Roach should fight with himself as this goes against his storied service record
  • you never really pay off the fact that Protagonist is able to reverse time, I believe that’s why Roach was unharmed by the reality stuff… but I think you need to build some foundation for this ability (not just an expo dump though)
  • I think the end sorta fizzles… why did he decide to take the target? Why does he feel this way? Those are questions could be left unanswered… but the time between Roach turning on his teammate and then the events played out earlier. Think you need to explain that too somewhere
